visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a grey textured sweater, stands outdoors in front of a 7-ELEVEN storefront. He holds a bright green 'CITY TEA' paper cup close to the camera, smiling broadly and speaking directly to the viewer. (2) The scene shifts indoors where the man holds the green cup alongside a small orange box of 'Nin Jiom' syrup. The background is a brightly lit convenience store interior with a 'CITY CAFE' sign visible. (3) A close-up shot shows the man squeezing thick, dark brown syrup from a small plastic packet into the green cup filled with tea. He holds the packet with his fingers, focusing on the liquid pouring in. (4) The man uses a clear straw to stir the drink and then takes a sip. His facial expression is one of pleasant surprise, eyes widening and nodding as he continues to speak enthusiastically. (5) A new scene presents a different green cup, this time filled with dark grass jelly and various toppings like sweet potato balls and red beans. He uses a white plastic spoon to lift the ingredients, showing their texture. (6) The man eats a spoonful of the grass jelly, closing his eyes in enjoyment. He holds the cup in one hand and the spoon in the other, with variety-show style text appearing around him. (7) The final phase returns to the outdoor setting in front of the 7-ELEVEN. He holds the green cup and gestures towards the camera, smiling and offering a final recommendation before the video ends.

(3) A distinct 'slurp' sound through a straw is heard, followed by a short pause and an excited vocal exclamation from the speaker. High-pitched, cute sound effects like bubbles and sparkles are layered in. (4) The speaker's pitch rises as he introduces the second item. The sound of a plastic spoon scraping against a cup is clearly audible, indicating the consumption of grass jelly. (5) More slurping and chewing sounds accompany the speaker's positive feedback.
